title: Toimija handoff record v1
description: A Toimija session handoff record. Evolution rules: new optional fields are additive within v1; any breaking change requires docs/schemas/handoff-record.v2.schema.json plus a version bump. Readers must tolerate unknown optional fields, matching SessionMarker's additive reader discipline.

version.description: Schema version for this handoff record. Version 1 is the only value emitted by this schema.

session_id.description: The Toimija session id that wrote the record.

written_at.description: Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the record was appended.

agent.description: Capped argv of the wrapped agent command from the session marker.

agent_total.description: Full argv entry count before the agent list was capped.

intent.description: The session's declared intent, when known.

branch.description: Live Git branch at handoff time, when available.

entry_head.description: HEAD recorded in the session marker at entry or latest refresh, when available.

head.description: Live HEAD oid at handoff time, when available.

merge_base.description: Live merge-base oid at handoff time, when available.

staged.description: Capped paths staged in the index at handoff time.

staged_total.description: Full staged path count before the staged list was capped.

unstaged.description: Capped paths modified in the worktree at handoff time.

unstaged_total.description: Full unstaged path count before the unstaged list was capped.

untracked.description: Capped untracked paths at handoff time.

untracked_total.description: Full untracked path count before the untracked list was capped.

conflicts.description: Capped conflicted paths at handoff time.

conflicts_total.description: Full conflict path count before the conflicts list was capped.

branch_scope.description: Capped changed surface from the context packet.

branch_scope_total.description: Full changed-surface count before the branch_scope list was capped.

suggested_validation.description: Capped rendered validation command strings: focused tier when present, otherwise fast tier. Toimija does not execute them.

suggested_validation_total.description: Full suggested validation command count before the list was capped.

coupling.description: Capped rendered coupling hints from the context packet.

coupling_total.description: Full coupling hint count before the coupling list was capped.

risk.description: Capped rendered risk hints from the context packet.

risk_total.description: Full risk hint count before the risk list was capped.

consistency_token.description: The context packet consistency token a successor can compare against the live repo.

next_step.description: Optional free-text note supplied by the handoff writer.

sauma.description: Optional Sauma attestation envelope for newly emitted records. Old v1 records omit it and remain valid.
